script_text: Taurus, the cosmic currents are shifting your strong earthy stability this week. Early on, your ruler Venus in the 5th House squares Saturn in the 11th, creating friction in romance and social circles, making Monday challenging. However, very quick relief arrives on Tuesday as Mercury in your 6th House trines Jupiter in the 3rd, clearing workplace communication and daily routines. The shift occurs mid-week when Mars in your 4th House forms a supportive trine to Jupiter, bringing harmony to family matters. Late week, the Sun in your 6th House aligns with Pluto in your 10th, signaling major career breakthroughs and professional growth, ideal for weekend career planning. Wednesday is your power day for clear communication, while Monday is your worst due to the Venus-Saturn square. Focus on turning your practical earth element into highly tangible career opportunities. Follow for daily updates to navigate these stars.
